response: For patients with advanced dilated and ischemic cardiomyopathy and severe functional mitral regurgitation (MR), mitral valve replacement is associated with higher in-hospital and late mortality compared to mitral valve repair. Therefore, mitral repair is the preferred approach whenever possible in this clinical setting. This suggests that mitral replacement and repair are not the same in terms of outcomes for these patients, with repair being the recommended option due to its association with better survival rates.
